title: Active Duty Review and Continuity Settings, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
For each **Referrals and Authorizations** type these settings fix whether an active duty service member's request passes a military review and whether an authorization survives a change of PCM or an enrollment transfer out of the TRICARE West Region.

| Authorization type | Active duty service member's civilian request goes through military clinic referral management | TRICARE Prime Remote service member's request needs the service point-of-contact review | Stays valid after the patient changes PCM | Stays valid after an enrollment transfer out of the West Region |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Specialty Care Referral | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Rehabilitative Therapy Referral | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Home Health Care Authorization | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization | no | no | yes | no |
| Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Inpatient Mental Health Authorization | yes | yes | yes | no |

## Points of reading

- Every type except the Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization requires both military reviews where they apply to the member.
- Every type survives a PCM change and none survives a transfer out of the West Region.
